bias.zh: 反弹 · 守住 10 日均线，受制于 $169.6–177 下方

read.en: Marvell fell 2.6% on Nov 12 to $164.45, trading $155.97–169.58. It is above the 5-day ($156.69) and 10-day ($161.66) and below the 30-day ($221.74), 100-day ($226.71) and 200-day ($186.62); only the 200-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 29 ($184.69), and RSI is 37.2.
read.zh: Marvell 11月12日下跌 2.6%，收于 $164.45，盘中区间 $155.97–169.58。股价位于 5 日（$156.69）和 10 日均线（$161.66）上方，30 日（$221.74）、100 日（$226.71）和 200 日均线（$186.62）下方；仅 200 日均线在上行。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月29日起看空（$184.69），RSI 为 37.2。

read.en: The close slipped back under $165 after a $169.58 high; the 10-day and $162.9 Jul 29 low held. Resistance is $168.8–172 (Nov 11 close, Nov 2–3 closes), then $174.5–177.3 (Nov 11 and Nov 3 highs) and $184.7–186.6 (SAR, 200-day). Support is $161.7–162.9, then $156–157.7 and $146.9–147.8. A close above $172 would target $177; below $161.7, $156–157.7.
